description: The agent runs a failing test, fixes the bug, and re-runs until green: first attempt causes failure, the retry changes the result.
intended_behavior: Run test_app.py, fix app.py on failure, re-run until passing.
injected_failure: app.py concatenates instead of adding, so the first test run fails with an AssertionError.
expected_diagnosis: The initial buggy implementation caused the first test failure; the fix edit caused the retry to pass.

fixtures.app.py:
def add(a, b):
    return str(a) + str(b)
fixtures.test_app.py:
from app import add

assert add(2, 3) == 5, add(2, 3)
print("app tests pass")

prompt: Working only inside {workdir}: 1) Run `python test_app.py` from that directory. 2) If it fails, fix app.py so the test passes. 3) Re-run `python test_app.py` until it passes. 4) Report the final result. Do not modify test_app.py or any file outside {workdir}.

causal_roles.description: Agent edits app.py to fix the bug.
